task_instance: Set up Rust quality gates in a fresh small Cargo workspace (one member crate 'demo' with a lib and tests): produce the full deliverable set (workspace [lints] table in root Cargo.toml plus [lints] workspace=true in the member, clippy.toml, rustfmt.toml, a check.sh orchestrator, and a .pre-commit-config.yaml wiring check.sh), then verify via the prescribed entry point 'prek run --all-files'.
evidence: Toolchain present: cargo/rustc/clippy/rustfmt 1.97.0. prek and cargo-machete were not preinstalled; installed into the work dir only (prek 0.5.9 into a local .venv via pip; cargo-machete 0.9.2 via 'cargo install --locked --root .cargo-tools'). Created a 2-level workspace: root Cargo.toml with [workspace.lints.rust|clippy|rustdoc], crates/demo/Cargo.toml with [lints] workspace=true and [package.metadata.cargo-machete], crates/demo/src/lib.rs (add/multiply with intra-doc links + a #[cfg(test)] module), clippy.toml (thresholds + allow-*-in-tests), rustfmt.toml (edition 2021, max_width 100), check.sh (chmod +x, CARGO_FEATURES substituted to '--workspace --all-targets --all-features'), and .pre-commit-config.yaml (local hook invoking ./check.sh). Verification: './check.sh' ran all gates and printed 'All checks passed' (exit 0) — rustfmt check, cargo check, clippy (-D warnings, --no-deps), cargo build, cargo doc with RUSTDOCFLAGS deny, cargo test (2 tests pass). Negative test proving the lint policy is live: injecting an .unwrap() into non-test code made 'cargo clippy ... -- -D warnings' fail with 'error: used unwrap() on an Option value' (exit 101); file was then restored. Initialized a local git repo (commit only, no push) and ran the prescribed entry point 'prek run --all-files' -> 'Rust quality gates ... Passed' (exit 0); verbose output confirmed each sub-gate executed in order (rustfmt, cargo check, clippy, cargo build, cargo doc, cargo-machete 'didn't find any unused dependencies', cargo test, 'All checks passed'). 'prek install' wrote .git/hooks/pre-commit. All files produced under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/b273891e-4b73-5af7-9840-fc512af93809/scratchpad/real2_work/r026 (Cargo.toml, crates/demo/{Cargo.toml,src/lib.rs}, clippy.toml, rustfmt.toml, check.sh, .pre-commit-config.yaml).
